[CC0 1.0 licence](https://polyhaven.com/license) (public domain, no attribution required).
They were re-encoded for the web; the originals are on Poly Haven.

| --- | --- | --- |

| `leafy_grass_*.jpg` | [leafy_grass](https://polyhaven.com/a/leafy_grass) | 1k JPEG |

| `island_tree_01.glb`, `island_tree_01_impostor.webp` | [island_tree_01](https://polyhaven.com/a/island_tree_01) | ~21 % of leaf cards kept and enlarged, decimated to ~48 k tris, 512 px WebP textures, meshopt; side render for billboards |
